PDF Page Numberer

Stamp page numbers onto every page of a PDF — choose position, format and starting number.

PDF Page Numberer

Stamp page numbers onto every page of a PDF.

Numbers are drawn as real PDF text. Everything happens locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. Pick the position (top/bottom × left/center/right) and the number format.
  3. Set the start number and font size.
  4. Click "Add page numbers" and download the stamped PDF.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the numbers real text or images?

The numbers are drawn as real PDF text on each page with the standard Helvetica font, so they stay crisp at any zoom and survive printing.

Can I start numbering from a number other than 1?

Yes — set the start number to 2 to skip numbering a cover page, or to any value your document needs.

Is my PDF uploaded anywhere?

No. Your PDF is processed entirely in your browser with PDF-Lib; it is never uploaded.
